reason: Pair the wheels with the gearmotors to prepare the rover's drive.
expectation: I expect a wheel-drive assembly that can be fitted to the deck.

alternatives.reason: The remote also needs power, but I want to start with the moving parts.

effect: The wheel drives are ready to fit, and the gearboxes trade speed for turning force.
reaction: The explanation of the gears makes the assembly more interesting.
reason: Fit the completed drives to the rover deck to give it powered wheels.
expectation: I expect the wheel drives to attach to the deck; the rover will still need its other components.

effect: The drives are fitted, and I understand that independently controlled wheels will steer the rover.
reaction: The two-wheel steering explanation is useful.
reason: Add the caster to complete the deck's physical support.
expectation: I expect the ball caster to fit into its slot and support the deck alongside the driven wheels.

effect: The caster is fitted, so the deck has its three support points.
reason: Add the receiver and motor driver so the rover can eventually control its wheels.
expectation: I expect the receiver and driver to fit into their deck slot, with connections still to be completed.

effect: The receiver and motor driver are fitted; the power and switch components remain.
reason: Fit the switch harness as part of the rover's electrical assembly.
expectation: I expect the harness to fit on the deck, with the switch kept off until assembly is complete.

effect: The switch harness is fitted; the battery pack remains to be added to the deck.
reason: Fit the battery pack to supply the rover's electrical system.
expectation: I expect the battery pack to fit in its slot, with the switch remaining off until the assembly is ready.

alternatives.reason: The remote needs batteries too, but I want to finish fitting the deck first.

effect: The battery pack is fitted, completing the listed deck slots; the gear guards and remote batteries remain.
reaction: The deck assembly is coming together, though the recent fittings have been repetitive.
reason: Fit the gear guards before operating the rover to cover its moving parts.
expectation: I expect the guards to cover the drive gears, leaving the remote to prepare and the rover to test.

alternatives.reason: The remote needs batteries, but I prefer to finish the rover's protective fittings first.
